QUERY:
SELECT
  'https://irsa.ipac.caltech.edu/' || a.uri || '?center=248.167610833,66.7549794172d&size=0.166666666667' AS access_url,
  p.planeid AS planeid,
  a.uri AS artifact_path,
  p.time_bounds_lower AS time_mjd,
  p.energy_bandpassname AS band,
  p.dataproducttype AS product,
  p.position_dimension_naxis1 AS width,
  p.position_dimension_naxis2 AS height,
  p.poly AS footprint,
  a.contentchecksum AS remote_checksum
FROM spherex.artifact AS a
JOIN spherex.plane AS p ON a.planeid = p.planeid
WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', 248.167610833, 66.7549794172), p.poly)
  AND a.producttype = 'science'
  AND a.contenttype = 'image/fits'
ORDER BY p.time_bounds_lower
